metadata.name: containment_hook
metadata.description: A Token-2022 transfer hook that keeps a token in its one home market until it unlocks

instructions.name: bind
docs: Binds a Token-2022 mint to its home market, once and for good: the unlock goal, in
quote-mint base units, and the unlock deadline, a Unix time.

accounts.name: mint_authority
docs: The mint's mint authority: only the launcher can bind a mint.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of the config and the validation account.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The mint to contain.

accounts.name: config
docs: Created here, so a second `bind` of the same mint fails.

accounts.name: extra_account_metas
docs: The validation account, created here and written by the handler.

accounts.name: unlock
docs: The unlock PDA, which must be the mint's transfer hook authority; it holds no data.

accounts.name: market
docs: The home market: the router's `Market` account.

accounts.name: market_state
docs: The tax AMM market state the `Market` records.

instructions.name: execute
docs: The transfer hook interface's `Execute`, which Token-2022 calls on every transfer of
a mint whose hook is this program.

accounts.name: source
docs: The source token account.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The mint.

accounts.name: destination
docs: The destination token account.

accounts.name: owner
docs: The source's owner or delegate.

accounts.name: extra_account_metas
docs: The validation account `["extra-account-metas", mint]`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The config `["config", mint]`.

errors.name: TransferRefused
errors.msg: A contained token can't be transferred there

errors.name: MintNotToken2022
errors.msg: The mint is not owned by Token-2022

errors.name: NotAMint
errors.msg: The account is not an initialized mint

errors.name: MintExtensionNotAllowed
errors.msg: The mint carries an extension the mint rules refuse

errors.name: FreezeAuthoritySet
errors.msg: A contained mint must have no freeze authority

errors.name: NotMintAuthority
errors.msg: The signer is not the mint's mint authority

errors.name: WrongHookProgram
errors.msg: The mint's transfer hook program is not this program

errors.name: WrongHookAuthority
errors.msg: The mint's transfer hook authority is not its unlock PDA

errors.name: ZeroGoal
errors.msg: The unlock goal must be above zero

errors.name: DeadlineNotInFuture
errors.msg: The unlock deadline must be later than now

errors.name: DeadlineTooFar
errors.msg: The unlock deadline may be at most MAX_UNLOCK_DEADLINE_SECS after the binding

errors.name: NotARouterMarket
errors.msg: The market is not a Market account of Pipeline's router

errors.name: MarketNotAtItsAddress
errors.msg: The Market account is not at its router PDA

errors.name: NotATaxMarket
errors.msg: The home market must run on the tax AMM

errors.name: MarketDoesNotHoldMint
errors.msg: The home market must trade the mint against one quote mint

errors.name: WrongMarketState
errors.msg: The market state is not the one the Market records

errors.name: NotATaxMarketState
errors.msg: The market state is not a tax AMM market state

errors.name: TaxSideNotQuote
errors.msg: The home market's tax must be taken in the quote mint

types.name: Config
docs: One contained mint's binding to its home market. `bind` writes it once; no instruction
changes it afterwards, and it is never closed, so it stays as the record of the token's
containment. Only `unlocked_at` will be set, once, by the unlock.

fields.name: version
docs: [`CONFIG_VERSION`].

fields.name: mint
docs: The contained mint.

fields.name: market
docs: The home market: the router's `Market` account.

fields.name: market_state
docs: The tax AMM market state the `Market` records.

fields.name: vault
docs: The contained token's vault in the home market, as the `Market` records it.

fields.name: fee_account
docs: The home market's Pipeline fee account for the contained token.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: The market's other mint, which its tax is taken in.

fields.name: unlock_goal
docs: The tax the home market must collect for the unlock, in quote-mint base units.

fields.name: unlock_deadline
docs: The Unix time from which the unlock is due whatever the tax collected.

fields.name: bound_at
docs: The Unix time of the binding.

fields.name: unlocked_at
docs: The Unix time of the unlock, or none while the token is contained.
